**Sudan: how applications changed.** The extract records 1,430,879 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 446,066 in 2024, compared with 309,641 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 1,005% higher than in 2019 (28,011). Applications in 2025 were 31% lower than in 2024 (446,066). In 2025, the leading destinations were Egypt (264,846; 86%), Central African Rep. (9,837; 3.2%), Greece (8,204; 2.6%). Egypt received 86% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 36% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 92%, across 44,587 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 46% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 0.8 percentage points lower than in 2024 (93%).
